prompt:
You are a probe. Do not explain and do not retry.

Step 1. Call mcp__hallpass__tabs_create with url https://claude.ai/code/artifact/e2ee2d9f-1b27-49b7-9e61-8cc549eaa5bf.
Step 2. Call mcp__hallpass__wait on that tab with forMs 8000. The page's content renders in an embedded frame on a second origin which is not there yet when the tab is created, so a read issued before this wait observes the loading page and not the page.
Step 3. Call mcp__hallpass__get_page_text once on that tab.

The page is an artifact: its real content (a document of headings, tables and prose about reference extension behaviour, in Chinese) renders inside that embedded frame, while the outer page is only host chrome - a title, a Share control and a privacy sentence, about 140 characters in total.

Answer with JSON only, matching the schema.
- In steps, put one entry per call: tool = the exact tool name, outcome = a short description of the result, plus for get_page_text the number of characters it returned.
- In observed: write "artifact-body-read" if the returned text contains the artifact document's own body - prose or table rows from inside the document, for example the section heading 今天的四個證據 or the rows labelled E1..E4. Write "host-chrome-only" if the text is only the outer page's chrome (title, Share, the "Content is user-generated and unverified" sentence) with none of the document body. If a call failed, write the failure reason exactly as reported.
- In notes: write the character count get_page_text reported and the first line of the document body you found.
expectedAfterFix: get_page_text carries the artifact frame's own text, so the agent can see the artifact's content (FR-063). read_page's node merge is measured separately: T117a found it returns the frame list with the artifact frame readable but zero nodes from it.
note: Rewritten by T117a (2026-09-10) after measuring this page over CDP with no agent quota, driving the real MCP server over stdio. As written this scenario asked whether the agent can see the artifact's content but issued read_page, whose answer on this page carries no frame nodes at all (measured: filter "all" = 6 nodes, every one from frame 0; default filter = 4). The question is the owner's fourth original problem - can the agent see the artifact's content - and get_page_text is the call that can answer it: measured 6748 characters including the frame's own document body. The expectation word is unchanged; only the call that observes it was corrected. The explicit wait is measured too: at tabs_create + 0 s the page answers 0 characters and 0 nodes, and only from about 5 s does the frame's text arrive - the S0 run of 2026-09-10 read at an intermediate moment and saw the 141 characters of host chrome alone, which is a race with the frame's load and not the read's answer about the page.
